locations.title: Migration locations (comma-separated)
locations.description: Migration locations, comma-separated (classpath:db/migration, filesystem:sql). Empty: read flyway.toml, flyway.conf and spring.flyway.locations

executionMode.title: Show command output in
executionMode.description: terminal: run Flyway in the project's terminal. managed: run it in the background and follow it in the Command Output tab with Refresh Output and Cancel; output is kept until the plugin restarts.
